$comment: Space, radius, and elevation. From Loro.dc.html. See docs/design/design-system.md

space.$comment: An 8px rhythm with 4px half-steps, plus the deviations the blueprint makes for density.

gutter.$comment: The blueprint varies the screen gutter by density: roomy on reading screens, tight on list-dense ones so rows get more width.

lg.use: THE WORKHOUSE — buttons, chips, rows, small cards. When unsure, it's 12

sheet.use: bottom sheet — asymmetric, wider at the bottom

shadow.$comment: Low, WARM-TINTED recipes. Stationery ambient shadows use surface.shadowInk (#231e18). There are no hard grey drop shadows. Mobile maps these CSS strings to RN shadow props in apps/mobile/src/ui/elevation.ts.

interactive.use: raised interactive cards — v1.2 dual shadow

raised.use: primary CTA — terracotta-tinted, which is what makes it feel warm rather than pasted on

methodContact.use: v1.3 idle/cancelled Google method + sign-out safe card — design-v1.3 shadow-[0_2px_4px_rgba(35,30,24,0.03)]

methodSoft.use: v1.3 connecting cancel / error Apple — warm extraction of Tailwind shadow-sm (no grey drop)

methodInset.use: v1.3 connecting method well — Tailwind shadow-inner geometry, fieldInset pigment
